components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The optional honorific title of the pet owner, one of MR, MRS, MS or DR.
            When supplied it drives the derived 'salutation'. Stored and returned when present.
          type: string
          maxLength: 10
          example: DR
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal (flat) address of the pet owner. Accepted for backward
            compatibility; when the structured 'addressLine1' is supplied it takes precedence.
            On a response this is the composed address - the normalized 'addressLine1' with the
            normalized 'addressLine2' appended after a single space when present.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: The first line of the structured postal address (street number and name).
            Preferred over the flat 'address' when supplied; normalized (upper-cased, whitespace
            collapsed, common abbreviations expanded) and returned. An owner is valid when it
            supplies an address in either form - a non-blank 'addressLine1' or the flat 'address'.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty Street'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: The optional second line of the structured postal address (unit, suite, etc.).
            Normalized like 'addressLine1' and, when present, appended to the composed 'address'
            after a single space.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Suite 5'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: The postal code of the pet owner. Optional; when present it must be exactly four
            digits and, when the city maps to a known region (Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC,
            Brisbane->QLD), fall within that region's range (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099,
            QLD 4000-4099). A city with no known region accepts any four-digit postcode. Stored and
            returned when supplied.
          type: string
          pattern: "^[0-9]{4}$"
          example: '2000'
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner. On create it may be supplied in national
            or international form (spaces, dashes and brackets are ignored); it is stored and returned
            in E.164 form (a leading '+' and country code, defaulting to '+61' when none is given).
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when present it must be a
            syntactically valid address and is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the pet owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
            Optional on create; when omitted it defaults to the server's current date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: The pet owner's date of birth, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format. Optional;
            when present it drives the derived ageBand (computed against the registrationDate).
            Stored and returned when supplied.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: Create-time flag only. When true, allows creating this owner even though
            another owner has the same last name and postcode (same household), admitting it as a
            declared household member (which is therefore not flagged as a possible duplicate);
            otherwise such a request is rejected with 409 Conflict. It does not affect the derived
            householdId, which is deterministic. Not persisted and not returned.
          type: boolean
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: The owner's salutation, the title followed by a single space and the
                last name (e.g. 'DR Franklin'), or just the last name when no title was supplied.
                Derived per response.
              type: string
              example: 'DR Franklin'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: The owner's customer code, formatted '<REGION>-<HASH8>' where REGION is the
                region code derived from the postcode (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099, else
                UNKNOWN) and HASH8 is the first 8 upper-case hex characters of SHA-256 over the
                normalized (E.164) telephone concatenated with the last name. Assigned at creation.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW-A1B2C3D4'
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: The owner's membership number, formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>' where
                <customerCode> is the owner's region-and-hash customer code and YY is the last two digits
                of the fiscal year (starting 1 July) of the business-day-adjusted registrationDate.
                Assigned at creation.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW-A1B2C3D4-M27'
              readOnly: true
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: The owner's fiscal year, formatted 'FY<YY>' where YY is the last two digits of
                the fiscal year (starting 1 July, identified by the calendar year it ends) of the
                business-day-adjusted registrationDate. Derived per response.
              type: string
              example: 'FY27'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: A deterministic identifier shared by all owners in the same household,
                computed as the first 12 hex characters of SHA-256 over the normalized last name and the
                postcode. Owners with the same last name and postcode share it automatically. Assigned
                at creation.
              type: string
              example: 'H-3f2a1c9b8e7d'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: The number of existing owners that, at the moment this owner was created,
                already shared the same first name and last name (compared case-insensitively).
                Assigned at creation.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            deleted:
              title: Deleted
              description: Whether this owner has been soft-deleted. A DELETE of the owner sets this
                true and retains the record rather than removing it; a newly created owner is false.
                A soft-deleted owner is still returned by GET but is ignored by the create endpoint's
                duplicate/identity checks.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            checkDigit:
              title: Check digit
              description: A single Luhn check digit (0-9) computed over the digits contained in the
                customerCode (non-digit characters ignored). Derived per response.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              maximum: 9
              example: 4
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: The owner's membership points. Starts at 0; add 2 when an email is present;
                add 1 when namesakeCount is 0; add 2 for a household of 3 or more members; add 3 for a
                tenure of at least one elapsed fiscal year (the registrationDate falling in an earlier
                fiscal year than today; fiscal years start 1 July). Derived per response.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: The owner's membership level, derived from membershipPoints - 1 for 0-1
                points, 2 for 2-3, 3 for 4-5, and 4 for 6 or more. Derived per response.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: The owner's locality, the REGION segment of the customerCode (the region code
                derived from the postcode at creation - NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099),
                or 'UNKNOWN' when the postcode resolves to no known region or no customer code is assigned.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: The owner's IANA timezone derived from the locality/region via the fixed
                region-to-timezone table (NSW -> Australia/Sydney, VIC -> Australia/Melbourne,
                QLD -> Australia/Brisbane), or absent when the locality maps to no known region.
                Derived per response.
              type: string
              example: 'Australia/Sydney'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: True when more than 80 owners have already been created for this owner's
                registration day, otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: True when another owner shares this owner's last name (case-insensitively) and
                postcode but has a different telephone - a soft near match. Always false for an owner
                admitted as a declared household member via 'sharesHousehold' (a declared member is not a
                suspected duplicate). Derived per response.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: The id of the existing owner this owner possibly duplicates (same last name and
                postcode, different telephone), or absent when possibleDuplicate is false. The earliest
                (lowest id) match when several match. Derived per response.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              example: 42
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: The owner's preferred contact channel, 'EMAIL' when an email is present,
                otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              enum:
                - EMAIL
                - PHONE
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: The owner's age band derived from birthDate against the registrationDate,
                'MINOR' when under 18, 'ADULT' when 18 to 64, or 'SENIOR' when 65 or older. Absent
                when no birthDate was supplied.
              type: string
              enum:
                - MINOR
                - ADULT
                - SENIOR
              example: 'ADULT'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: The owner's derived identity key, formatted
                '<normalizedTelephone>|<email or empty>|<householdId>'. A descriptive derived value;
                create-time duplicate detection is keyed on the household (same last name and postcode).
              type: string
              example: '+61412345678||H-3f2a1c9b8e7d'
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone (display)
              description: The stored E.164 telephone formatted for humans - the country code (with its
                leading '+'), a space, then the national digits grouped in threes (e.g. '+61412345678'
                -> '+61 412 345 678'). The raw telephone stays in E.164 form. Derived per response.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets
